0.text: $NAME! You don’t know how glad I am to see you. You're wearing the garb of the Patreayl Knights I see…

1.text: And as you can see, the relationship between Highsteppe and the Order has changed considerably since we last spoke…. I don’t know why they are attacking us, but I’ve heard stories of the Inquisitors from when I was a child.

2.text: Nasty pieces of work they were, but nothing could prepare me for this… slaughter! Please, $NAME for all our sake, help us fend off these vile men!

0.text: Since you have left, I still remain as the commander of the Guardians. The Inquisitors believe if they kill me, then the rest of the Guardians will fall in line.

1.text: We must protect this village! I'll sound the alarm. Wait for me here and prepare for battle.

0.text: $NAME, you've returned to us, and your timing could not be better. You get to see what your actions have wrought upon your home!

1.text: Why else would these "Inquisitors" come here, and prepare a siege on our peaceful hamlet? If the spark of a Guardian still burns somewhere within you, then help us.

2.text: Undo your mess. It’s not fair that we should suffer your betrayal of the Order!
